fuel_consumption.source_quote: A one-cent change in the cost per gallon of fuel has an impact on our operating expenses of approximately $1.2 million, based on 2005 consumption.

instrument_type_details.notes: NYMEX heating oil contracts liquidated May 2005; switched to OTC jet fuel forward contracts with single counterparty. Strategy: hedge ~45% of fuel consumption needs for succeeding 12 months. Fair value $2.4M at Dec 31 2005 for ~30% of 2006 needs. As of March 2006: 59% Q2, 41% Q3, 0% Q4. Credit exposure $4.3M.

warnings: Volume (gallons) not disclosed; only percentage of anticipated fuel needs reported; 45% strategy applies to next 12-month period
